Font.Metadata.Tool
Usage: font-metadata inspect <path> [<path> ...] [options]
       font-metadata inspect - [options]
       font-metadata inspect-license <path> [<path> ...] [--format plain|json]
       font-metadata --help | --version
Inspect options: --format plain|json (default: plain), --include-name-records, --include-unicode-coverage, --include-variation-axes, --analyze-licenses, --analyze-spdx, --max-input-bytes <bytes>
Use -- before literal paths beginning with '-'. Stdin '-' must be the only source.
Reads SFNT/TTC, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT. No embedded search or directory traversal.
Design axes are shown for declared fvar tables. Use --include-variation-axes to report the status for every face.
Input defaults to 128 MiB; additional library decoding limits apply (see docs/cli.md).
inspect-license reads explicit UTF-8 files up to 1 MiB each (optional UTF-8 BOM). It reports SPDX declarations, license headings and verified texts from the built-in catalog.
License hints are evidence, not a license decision.
Exit codes: 0 complete, 1 incomplete/unrecognized, 2 arguments, 3 I/O, 130 cancellation.
